simple.meaning: בְּדִיל (bᵉdîyl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Numbers 31:22. The surrounding context includes family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּדִיל (H913) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: בְּדִיל (bᵉdîyl) / H913 is traced through Numbers 31:22, Isaiah 1:25, Ezekiel 22:18, Ezekiel 22:20 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: however the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
I will turn my hand on you,
“Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.

As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it; so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.
“ ‘ “Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.

Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

definitions.short: alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin
definitions.full: H913. bedil בְּדִיל noun [masculine] alloy, tin, dross (originally that which is separated from precious metal; compare Plin Hist. Nat. xxiv. 16, xxxiii. 9 ) — ׳בּ absolute Num 31:22 4 t.; Plural suffix בְּדִילָ֑יִךְ Isa 1:25 ; — 1 alloy , Isa 1:25 figurative of evil of Jerusalem, which ׳י will remove ( הֵסִיר ; || סִגָ֑יִךְ ). 2 tin ( plumbum album ) Num 31:22 (P; + עֹפָ֑רֶת בַּרְזֶל, נְחשֶׁת, כֶּסֶף, זָהָב, ); figurative of Israel Ezek 22:18 (+ עוֺפֶרֶת בַּרְזֶל, נְחשֶׁת, ); in simile 22:20 (+ id. + כֶּסֶף ); as article of commerce brought to Tyre from Tarshish 27:12 (+ עוֺפֶרֶת בַּרְזֶל, כֶּסֶף, ). 3 plummet , הַבְּדִיל הָאֶבֶן (appositive) Zech 4:10 .
